name: Mickey's Smokestack BBQ Carved Texas Smoked Beef Brisket (Standalone)
whyItWorks: Slow-smoked for 12+ hours until collagen melts; the lean "flat" cut of brisket is zero-fiber, dairy-free, and citrus-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the carver for lean slices from the flat cut (not the fatty point), trim off the black-pepper outer bark edge, and eat without spicy BBQ sauce.
watchOuts: Coarse black pepper on outer bark edge
Fatty point cut if not requested lean
